name: 40917-visionchat-4b-1gpu
architecture: Granite4VisionForConditionalGeneration, bf16, 3.997B params: a SigLIP2 vision encoder feeding a 40-layer language stack. All shapes are in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, 100 requests bounded, warmup 10%, cooldown 10% -> 80 measured
workload: single-turn image+text chat: one 384x384 JPEG plus 64 synthetic text tokens in, 256 tokens out, 100 requests, one at a time
purpose: A single-user visual chat assistant answering one photo plus a short question at a time on one GPU.
launch:
# This engine's AsyncEngineArgs rejects an unknown key with a TypeError at construction, so a key
# carried over from a later vLLM fails the run rather than being ignored.
model: ibm-granite/granite-vision-4.1-4b
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-model-len: 4096
tensor-parallel-size: 1
enforce-eager: false
